name: Ovonic 3S 2200 mAh 50C LiPo
description: 11.1 V 3S LiPo pack, 2200 mAh, 50C, with an XT60 plug. Sold in pairs.

specs.label: Chemistry
specs.value: Li-Po (lithium polymer), soft pouch cells in a shrink-wrapped pack

specs.label: Voltage
specs.value: 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full (4.2 V per cell)

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: 179 g ±20 g (AU page); the US page says 168 g

envelope.axes: x = length 105 mm (lead end at +X), y = width 33 mm, z = height 21 mm (label face up)

features.label: Overall
features.source: Ovonic spec list (ovonicshop.com and us.ovonicshop.com) and dimension image 3s-dimensions.jpg (105 mm, 33 mm, 21 mm)

features.label: Body shape
features.value: Rectangular soft pack: stacked pouch cells in black heat-shrink wrap, long edges visibly rounded (radius not given), flat faces. Label printed on the top face (no geometry).

features.label: Lead end
features.value: Both the main leads (red and black silicone wire) and the JST-XH balance lead leave the same short end, where the cell tabs are folded and covered by the wrap. Exit positions and lead lengths are not published. Leads and plugs are not modeled.

features.label: Tolerances
features.value: Length ±5 mm, width ±2 mm, height ±2 mm, weight ±20 g ("dev." values on the spec list)

notes: Ovonic publishes no CAD and no dimensioned drawing: only L × W × H with tolerances (length ±5 mm, width and height ±2 mm, weight ±20 g) and product photos. Model the pack at the nominal L × W × H as one soft shrink-wrapped block (black wrap, label on the top face) with gently rounded long edges, the way the photos show it. The stated length is the pack body; the main leads and the balance lead both leave the same short end (pose: that end toward +X), and leads and plugs are not modeled. Edge radii, the lead-end tab fold and the lead exit positions are not dimensioned.
